_comment: TEMPLATE ONLY — never loaded. Copy to $DRYDOCK_CONFIG_DIR/<owner>_<repo>.json (default ~/.drydock/configs) and edit. Runtime config lives outside this repository on purpose: testCommand is executed to decide whether a branch may be pushed, and while it lived under factory/ it was inside drydock's own path allowlist. Fields: repo must equal the registry entry; modelId may be "auto"; commands run as argv and shell metacharacters are rejected.
